SymbolicEssence.ArchetypalFunction: To spin the thread of life at birth; to determine the moment and circumstances of each soul's beginning.
SymbolicEssence.SymbolicCore: The beginning of all life threads, the spinner who starts every destiny.

MythicAppearances: Daughter of Zeus and Themis (or Nyx)
CulturalContext.ReligiousOrRitualUse: Invoked at births; honored with her sisters as the Fates; present at every birth with her spindle.
CulturalContext.HistoricalEvolution: Ancient pre-Olympian fate goddess; absorbed into classical pantheon; influenced Roman Nona.

SymbolicRepresentation.ImageryNotes: Depicted as youngest of three sisters, holding spindle and distaff, spinning the thread of life; often crowned with stars.
SymbolicRepresentation.PoeticInvocation: Clotho, spinner of life's first thread, who begins every story at the spindle.
SymbolicRepresentation.DreamForm: A gentle woman spinning endless thread from starlight, each strand becoming a new life

MetaIntegration.RitualFunction: Invoked at births, new beginnings, and when seeking understanding of one's natal destiny.
AIPromptSeeds: The spinner who begins every life thread, determining what you will become.
The youngest fate whose spindle never stops, creating new destinies endlessly.
NarrativeHooks: The moment of birth that determines everything
The thread that connects to destiny
